content:
Apple TV will release a brand-new original comedy series "Brothers" next month, starring Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson. Here is the trailer.

"The Office" showrunner Lee Eisenberg produces comedy series "Brothers," premiering September 23

Apple TV is currently airing season 4 of "Ted Lasso," but another highly anticipated comedy is about to debut.

McConaughey and Harrelson star in "Brothers," a brand-new original series in which they play fictionalized versions of themselves.

"Brothers" will premiere its first two episodes on September 23 (Wednesday), then release one new episode weekly until November 4.

The series is created by Lee Eisenberg, who was part of the core creative team behind the classic sitcom "The Office," serving as a writer and producer from seasons 2 through 6.

Here is the synopsis provided by Apple for "Brothers," along with the trailer:

Also coming to Apple TV in September is "Brothers," along with a new season of "Slow Horses," the original crime thriller "Last Seen," and the Ryan Reynolds film "Mayday."

What did you think of the "Brothers" trailer? Share your thoughts in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, or you can subscribe at a discount through the Apple One bundle.
